definitions.expected_online_calculation: Use the deployed online feature-definition version.
definitions.leakage_notes: Version metadata; not a model input.
definitions.offline_calculation: literal v1

definitions.default_or_null_policy: non-null hash
definitions.description: Stable SHA-256 hash of feature and identity values excluding _feature_generated_at.
definitions.expected_online_calculation: Use the same stable field ordering and serialization in online parity checks.
definitions.leakage_notes: Audit metadata; not a model input.
definitions.offline_calculation: sha2(to_json(struct(stable feature values)), 256)

definitions.default_or_null_policy: copied from Silver _record_hash
definitions.description: Silver customer transaction record hash used for lineage.
definitions.expected_online_calculation: Carry source transaction event hash or equivalent event checksum.
definitions.leakage_notes: Lineage metadata; not a model input.
definitions.offline_calculation: Select _record_hash from the source Silver transaction.

grain: one row per Silver customer transaction

label_attachment_policy.multiple_label_rule: latest label_timestamp, then latest ingestion_timestamp, then latest source_timestamp, then descending event_id
label_attachment_policy.target_field: is_fraud renamed to target_is_fraud in the training dataset

point_in_time_policy.identical_timestamp_policy: strict exclusion; events at the exact same timestamp are not previous events
point_in_time_policy.market_candle_rule: latest completed candle with candle_end_timestamp <= feature_timestamp
